label: Storm Air Elemental
identity: Storm air spirit made of continuous DARK SLATE/INDIGO wind ribbons over a deep charcoal-blue core. Pale steel-blue ribbon crests and restrained silver-white static seams integrated along wind planes. Swept-back wind crest, narrow icy-white eyes FRONT only. TWO joined wind arms and condensed hands, SINGLE tapered spiralling vortex column and curled base, NO legs/feet/robes/armor. Darker and heavier than pale Gale, but silhouette and anatomy consistent. Glides on coiled base; right forearm sweeps forward for natural strike. Whirlwind spreads arms/connected coils around core. Gale Blast gathers hands then thrusts both palms FORWARD. Down one connected collapsed wind knot, no separate wisps.

label: Magma Earth Elemental
identity: Massive hunched rough BASALT/CHARCOAL volcanic boulder body, dark burgundy lower shadow planes, sparse fixed molten ORANGE/AMBER fissures in rock seams, tiny pale yellow-orange hot seam accents. Narrow amber-orange eyes FRONT only in recessed rock head, broad crag shoulders. TWO heavy arms/fists continuously joined at rock elbows/wrists; TWO short heavy legs with joined blocky feet. No floating rocks, external flames, neon runes, carried weapons, crystals or clothes. Shape matches rough sandstone Earth but distinct dark volcanic materials; do not turn it into a glossy armored robot. Slow alternating four-key heavy gait. Natural right fist punches forward. Tremor raises both fists then slams at ground in front; Aegis crosses forearms at chest. Down whole body slumps low, all rocks/limbs joined.

label: Swamp Water Elemental
identity: Heavy murky SWAMP water spirit: deep OLIVE/PEAT GREEN liquid core, muted moss-green wave planes, sparse warm OCHRE/CREAM foam rims and small fixed algae-like green streaks joined to liquid. Swept-back curled wave crest, narrow yellow-amber eyes FRONT only. TWO heavy water arms/hands continuously joined at elbows/shoulders, SINGLE tapering water column and low joined curled pool base, NO human legs/feet/clothes/robes or independent plants. Same heavy rounded wave anatomy as Sea variant but green/brown reflective liquid instead of turquoise. Slower-looking glide on flowing base, no humanoid walk. Right palm surges forward for natural Wave Slam. Tidal Crush gathers chest wave then heaves both connected arms/wave FORWARD. Undertow reaches forward then pulls elbows into ribs forming connected inward spiral. Down one low joined water mound, no detached droplets.
